title: With the help of AI, I made a web simulation game where you play a footballer's whole career from 16, with daily & weekly challenges.
author: K-17-DB
selftext: Please visit \[footballcareer.uk\] for the game, and tell me how you feel about it!

comments.author: K-17-DB
comments.body:
Solo dev here. In my game, you start at 16 at a real club, and every season plays out match by match. Somewhere in each season you'll hit a decision you can't skip: a transfer offer, a loan, a contract standoff, a big moment in a final.

A full career takes about 25 minutes on your phone. There's a daily challenge where everyone gets the same starting hands, and a weekly one where you take over a real player. This week it's 23-year-old Eden Hazard at today's Chelsea. There are leaderboards for you to compete.

Your players grow by playing, not by earning. Sign for a giant at 19, sit on the bench for two years, and you've lost your best development years.

Quick context: this launched in my country a few months ago and somehow found an audience. It gets about 800 players a day now. This week I finally put out the English version.

Free, no ads, nothing to buy. I've shipped over 100 updates since launch and I'm not stopping. If something feels off, tell me.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/K-17-DB please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.
